verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents on-call schedules managed from a built-in web UI or a shared Google calendar, standard rotation templates that pre-fill the calendar, and one-click overrides and cover requests. Its complex-schedules docs show per-time-zone schedules (EU, US West, Asia/Pacific) combined for 24/7 follow-the-sun coverage. missing for 10: explicit schedule layers within a single rotation, explicit round-robin assignment, detailed rotation configuration docs (handoff times, shift lengths), independent or hands-on corroboration.
